percentileRule: nearest-rank for n=21; p95 is rank 20; max is the largest raw sample
rawSamples: All five warmups and 21 measured values are in the referenced per-case JSON records.
timingCaveats: Node base-run and fixed-fresh-source stage 1-7 measurements came from separate source compilations; source bytes are identical but generated runtime IDs and prepared-input hashes are execution-scoped.
Node fixed-exact-base-request stages 4-7 and Rust base/fixed stage 8-10 use the same frozen request content identified by the base run metadata.
capture, readiness, and snapshot-index timings are nested within evaluate_document; they must not be added to stage 9.
Base and fixed Rust test binaries are both Release test profile, but are different binary identities; no absolute speed threshold is used.
